experience.highlights: Implemented core backend services in NodeJS for a greenfield MVP, architecting a high-precision billing calculation engine using exact decimal arithmetic to enforce strict financial compliance. Designed modular, reusable core platform APIs, allowing regional client configurations and localized feature variations to be deployed with minimal overhead. Engineered an event-driven S3 ingestion feature for pricing files, decoupling heavy file parsing from main services and improving system throughput for large datasets.

Drove the design and implementation of an automated multi-step collection debt allocation and collection process that recovered £2M+ in debt while reducing manual processing overhead by 85%. Contributed to both frontend and backend, developing new features end-to-end for web applications using Vue.js, TypeScript, and Kotlin across customer-facing and internal back-office platforms. Optimised the booking portal for smart meter install to enhance user experience, resulting in better conversion rates.

Developed a React web application with an Express backend, integrating the HP Siteflow API to enable users to view and manage over 200 printing devices. This solution improved productivity by providing enhanced visibility and simplifying troubleshooting processes.

Maintenance and administration of AD Environment including security and policies. Creating scripts for automation to improve tasks and software deployment. Managing Windows Servers and Linux workstations used in the factory.
